en-US.description: Offline push-to-talk dictation for Lithuanian, Russian and English - text appears in any program.
en-US.longDescription:
Hold the right Ctrl key, speak, release - the recognised text is typed into
whatever program has the cursor (Word, browser, chat, accounting software).
Speech recognition runs entirely on your own computer: audio and text never
leave it, there is no account and no subscription.
Lithuanian is recognised by LT_ausys - Kristijonas Jakubsonas' kmynas v4
(NVIDIA Parakeet fine-tuned on the LIEPA-3 corpus, CC BY 4.0), converted to
ONNX so it runs on the CPU. Russian is recognised by GigaAM v3 (SberDevices),
English by faster-whisper large-v3. The Lithuanian and Russian models place
punctuation and capitals themselves and need no graphics card: about 0.05 s
per command and about a second per minute of dictation on the author's CPU. Long
recordings are cut at pauses; silence types nothing. Spoken Lithuanian and
Russian numerals can be converted to digits with the right cases.
Choose one or two dictation languages during installation (install with
--interactive to see the language page); the UI follows the first one.
Switch languages mid-dictation with the arrow keys while Ctrl is held.
The installer is small (~95 MB). On first launch the program asks before
downloading the models it needs for the chosen languages (about 1 GB for
Lithuanian, 0.23 GB for Russian, 3.1 GB for English). After that it works
offline. For English, an NVIDIA GPU is detected automatically and CUDA
libraries are offered as an optional download.
Not signed with a paid certificate, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning on
first run. The SHA-256 of every release file is published next to it.
en-US.name: Diktuokle
